verdict.rationale: Omarchy documents an `omarchy` CLI that AI agents can use, and it has a plugin ecosystem, so versioned interfaces and a deprecation policy are a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence describes API versioning, compatibility guarantees, or any deprecation policy. Probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
